tools.name: create_scoreboard
tools.description: Create a public, shareable two-team scoreboard at zero. Requires explicit user intent to create; title and team names are public. Free boards allow 50 total spectator views and show branding. Retry the identical requestId and input after a timeout.

tools.name: get_scoreboard
tools.description: Read a scoreboard created through this API by the connected account, including stable team IDs and current revision.

tools.name: list_scoreboards
tools.description: List the connected account's API-created generic scoreboards. Does not list unrelated legacy boards. Pass nextCursor as cursor to continue until null; a filtered page can be empty.

tools.name: update_scoreboard
tools.description: Atomically set exact scores, increment scores, rename teams or change title. Use stable team IDs and the last read revision. Updates immediately appear publicly. On revision_conflict read the board and decide again; do not blindly replay a stale increment. Identical retry IDs return the previous res

tools.name: hand_off_scoreboard
tools.description: Return the connected account owner’s private management link. Share it only with the intended scorer, never spectators. Does not transfer ownership. Reuse requestId on retry.
